[[File:Kota_stormtrooper.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Rahm Kota/Legends|Kota]] kept [[Rahm Kota's lightsaber|his]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in a sheath on his back.]]
A '''sheath''' was a piece of clothing, often strapped to the waist, which held a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] when not in use. The [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] carried a sheath that contained his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> he brought his blaster out of its sheath and pointed it at the [[Quesoth]] [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
